title: Roster Merge Candidates Response
description: GET acx/v1/roster/persons/{id}/merge-candidates. Ranked survivor persons for a loser person. PHP resolves loser person → bound cluster UUIDs, calls GET /recognition/clusters/{cluster_id}/merge-candidates once per bound cluster, maps candidate clusters → bound persons through the projection, and aggregates per person. Person aggregation excludes candidates whose person_id equals the probe person_id; the service drops them. similarity is the max over remaining pairs; band is the band of that max; shared_media_count is the projection media-row count. A candidate cluster with no bound person is dropped. Every emitted number traces to a service value or a projection count; PHP invents none (rg-015).

person_id.description: Loser roster person id from the request path (acx_persons.id).

candidates.description: Ranked survivor persons. Similarity DESC, then name ASC within band. SPA step 2 renders this order; step 1 MUST NOT fetch or display it.

person_id.description: Survivor roster person id. Person aggregation excludes candidates whose person_id equals the probe person_id; the service drops them.

name.description: Display name from the bound person row.

similarity.description: Max service similarity across the loser person's bound clusters and this person's bound clusters after dropping self-person_id candidates. Service similarity is max(centroid cosine, latest pending ClusterMergeSuggestion similarity) over the canonical unordered pair (min uuid, max uuid); only pending suggestions not older than the latest cluster mutation. Ranking cosine only; not a calibrated probability. May be negative (band none). The band rule applies after that max.

band.description: Band of the max-similarity pair, copied from the service candidate. Same vocabulary as recognition-cluster-merge-candidates-response. Unknown values MUST be treated as none.

shared_media_count.description: Count of projected media rows shared between the loser and this survivor. From the projection, never count(payload) (rg-015).
